work_item.title: Web | Checkout | Prevent duplicate orders when checkout is retried
work_item.description_html:
Current behavior

Retrying checkout after a timeout can create two orders.

Expected behavior

Retrying the same request creates only one order.

Scope

Checkout retry handling and regression tests

Acceptance criteria

  • Repeating the same request creates one order
  • A failed first attempt can be retried
  • The existing successful checkout flow still works
